newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games sees charge on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games sees charge on acquisition.

text.p: Scientific Games Holdings Corp said Wednesday it had completed the purchase of Tele Control from Autotote Corp for about $25 million, and as a result it expects to recognize a one-time write-off for in-process technology.
The company said the exact amount of the writeoff will be determined in the next few months and will be taken against the second quarter earnings, which are scheduled to be announced on July 21.
Tele Control is an on-line lottery and transaction processing company located in Vienna, Austria, with revenues for fiscal year 1996 of approximately $27 million.

"The purchase of Tele Control marks our re-entry into the on-line lottery business and continues our long-term growth strategy of expansion into international markets," said chief executive William G. Malloy.
